theme: Replication stress and DNA damage response at stalled forks
core_role: The shared pathways frame replication-stress lesions (camptothecin/hydroxyurea damage, R-loops, DNA-protein crosslinks, origin firing control) as the damage that triggers PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation, checkpoint signalling and break-site chromatin repair.

theme: Methionine cycle and cobalamin/folate one-carbon metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are the methionine/SAM cycle and its inherited defects, framed as the methylation endpoint that depends on cobalamin and folate supply for remethylation of homocysteine.

theme: Rho GTPase-driven actin remodelling for cell motility
core_role: The shared pathways are the Rac/Rho GTPase-to-Arp2/3 and formin nucleation signals that build lamellipodia, framed as the upstream drivers of leading-edge actin dynamics, migration and macropinocytosis.

theme: RAS-MAPK signalling and its negative feedback
core_role: The shared pathways describe negative feedback on RAS-ERK signalling (phosphatases, RSK, Ras inhibition), framed as the brake on a cascade driven by oncogenic RAS, RAF and MAP2K mutants.

theme: Nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport for glycoconjugates
core_role: The shared pathways cover synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid and UDP-glucose, GPI anchoring and glycosphingolipid synthesis, framed as the sugar-donor supply and its use whose Golgi transport by SLC35 carriers fails in CDGs.

theme: Selective autophagy clearing misfolded protein aggregates
core_role: The shared pathways are the autophagy routes (aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated, microautophagy, nutrient-responsive autophagy) framed as the degradation machinery that clears aggresome-sequestered misfolded proteins.

theme: Misfolded protein aggregation and its autophagic clearance
core_role: The shared pathways describe misfolded-protein recognition, oligomerization, perinuclear sequestration and Josephin DUB/ER-phagy processing, framed as the protein-quality-control front end that feeds aggregates into aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy.

theme: PAX3/AP-2 transcriptional control of neural crest cadherins
core_role: The shared PAX3 target sets frame PAX3 as the transcription factor whose targets, together with AP-2 and DNA-binding regulation, control cadherin (CDH1, CDH11, CDH19) expression in neural crest-derived cells.

theme: FGFR4/Klotho signalling to MAPK, PI3K and PLC
core_role: The shared pathways are betaKlotho-dependent FGFR4 activation and its FRS/SHC-to-MAPK branch, framed as one arm alongside PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades downstream of FGF receptors.

theme: FGFR-RAS-MAPK signalling and its oncogenic dysregulation
core_role: The shared pathways are the core RAS-ERK module with its feedback inhibition and RAS/MAP2K mutant signalling, framed as the common downstream hub fed by FGFR (and IGF1R) receptor activation and RAF mutants.

theme: Endocrine control of body growth and metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and IGF receptor signalling via JAK-STAT, framed as the somatotropic and metabolic hormone axis interacting with HPA-axis glucocorticoid secretion.

theme: Mitochondrial respiratory chain assembly and oxidative phosphorylation
core_role: The shared pathways are inner-membrane protein insertion and assembly of complexes I and III, framed as the building of the electron transport chain that drives oxidative phosphorylation.

theme: Platelet activation, degranulation and cytoskeletal signalling
core_role: The shared pathways cover platelet activation, SNARE-dependent granule secretion and integrin-actin cytoskeletal remodelling, framed as the effector response of platelets triggered by thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signalling.

theme: IL-12-driven Th1 and NKT cell immunity
core_role: The shared pathways are NK T cell differentiation, proliferation and activation, framed as an innate-like lymphocyte arm of the IL-12/IFN-gamma Th1 response initiated by activated dendritic cells.

theme: Microglial neuroinflammation in amyloid-associated neurodegeneration
core_role: The shared pathways describe microglial activation, migration, proliferation and cytotoxicity in response to amyloid-beta, framed as the neuroinflammatory driver of hippocampal neuron death and synaptic impairment.

theme: Telomere maintenance via replication and recombination repair
core_role: The shared pathways cover telomere replication, capping, t-loop/D-loop handling and break-induced replication, framed as telomere-specific uses of the helicase, strand-invasion and DSB repair machinery.

theme: Rho family GTPase signalling to the actin cytoskeleton
core_role: The shared pathways are the CDC42, RHOG, RHOJ and RAC3 GTPase cycles, framed as the switch-level signalling that activates WASP/WAVE and Arp2/3 to build lamellipodia.

theme: B cell identity and B cell receptor activation
core_role: The shared pathways are B cell gene signatures and BCR signalling positive regulation, framed as the mature/naive B cell identity and antigen-receptor activation programme leading toward plasma cell differentiation.

theme: Vesicle targeting in ER-Golgi trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways describe vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi, framed as the targeting step of COPI/COPII-mediated anterograde and retrograde early secretory traffic.

theme: Water-soluble vitamin and cofactor metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover riboflavin, thiamine, choline and carnitine metabolism and transport, framed as part of a broad vitamin/cofactor metabolism theme alongside cobalamin, folate, biotin and methionine one-carbon pathways.

theme: Branching morphogenesis of glandular epithelia
core_role: The shared pathways describe mammary and prostate gland epithelial development, differentiation and branching, framed as instances of epithelial-mesenchymal branching morphogenesis shared with lung, salivary and other glands.

theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA turnover
core_role: The shared pathways are cleavage and polyadenylation of pre-mRNAs, framed as the 3'-end maturation step that is counterbalanced by decapping and exonucleolytic mRNA decay.

theme: Isoprenoid and sterol biosynthesis with vitamin K/quinone metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are the mevalonate-isoprenoid route to cholesterol (lanosterol, Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell), framed as the source of prenyl precursors also used for ubiquinone and vitamin K quinones that support gamma-carboxylation.

theme: Notch signalling and transcriptional regulation of targets
core_role: The shared pathways are Notch-driven HLH target transcription, framed as the nuclear output of NOTCH1-4 intracellular domains in development, T helper differentiation and oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants.

theme: Neutrophil activation, degranulation and antimicrobial response
core_role: The shared pathways cover neutrophil degranulation and myeloid effector activation via complement receptors, framed as the deployment of the granule antimicrobial arsenal by recruited, formyl-peptide-stimulated neutrophils.

theme: p53 regulation in DNA damage response
core_role: The shared pathways describe phosphorylation- and ubiquitin-dependent control of p53 stability and activity (and Cdc25A degradation), framed as the DNA damage checkpoint signalling governed by kinase/phosphatase balance.

theme: FLT3 and cytokine receptor signalling to STAT5 in leukemia
core_role: The shared pathways cover FLT3 (including fusion and ITD mutants) signalling through SRC kinases and STAT5 with CBL negative regulation, framed as the oncogenic driver signalling targeted by TKIs, alongside erythropoietin receptor signalling.

theme: Hormonal control of organism growth
core_role: The shared pathways are leptin signalling and regulation of body growth, framed as part of the growth hormone/IGF JAK-STAT axis controlling organismal growth.

theme: Axon guidance by repulsive and attractive cues
core_role: The shared pathways are semaphorin-plexin and netrin signalling for axon extension and repulsion, framed as two of several guidance systems (with Slit-Robo and ephrins) that steer growth cones via Rho GTPases.

theme: Membrane transport of ions and osmolytes
core_role: The shared pathways cover magnesium and inositol transport and homeostasis plus oligomeric membrane protein assembly, framed as osmotic/ionic homeostasis via channels and junctional paracellular transport under salt stress.

theme: Semaphorin-mediated axon guidance and sprouting
core_role: The shared pathways are Sema3A-plexin repulsion and semaphorin interactions in axonogenesis and sympathetic innervation, framed as the guidance signals controlling axon extension and collateral sprouting.

theme: Host-pathogen interactions and bacterial toxin entry
core_role: The shared pathways cover bacterial toxin uptake, anti-infective/anti-inflammatory host responses and NADPH oxidase activation, framed as host-pathogen interaction alongside bacterial attachment and invasion of host cells.

theme: Antigen presentation and cytotoxic lymphocyte activation
core_role: The shared pathways describe dendritic cell differentiation, lipid (CD1) and protein antigen presentation, framed as the antigen-presenting side that activates T, NK and NKT cell responses and tolerance.

theme: snRNP biogenesis and pre-mRNA processing and export
core_role: The shared pathways cover snRNP assembly, snRNA cap hypermethylation and transport and splicing, framed as the spliceosome machinery within broader mRNA processing, 3'-end formation and nuclear export.

theme: Antigen processing and MHC presentation
core_role: The shared pathways are MHC class II and lipid antigen processing and presentation and their regulation, framed as the core function of professional antigen-presenting cells such as dendritic cells and monocytes.

theme: Chromatin assembly and histone acetylation
core_role: The shared pathways cover nucleosome assembly, histone/protein acetylation and repair-coupled chromatin remodelling, framed as chromatin organization regulating replication, repair and senescence-associated heterochromatin.

theme: Post-translational and tRNA residue modification for translation
core_role: The shared pathways are protein hydroxylation of lysine/proline residues, framed as one type of amino-acid side-chain modification alongside tRNA modification, hypusination and diphthamide synthesis that support translation.

theme: Centriole, basal body and primary cilium biogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways cover centriole duplication/elongation, basal body docking and cilium assembly/disassembly regulation, framed as the centriole-based foundation for ciliogenesis and intraflagellar ciliary trafficking.

theme: DNA repair synthesis and translesion replication
core_role: The shared pathways cover replicative DNA synthesis, PCNA-mediated polymerase switching and translesion synthesis, framed as the DNA synthesis steps used in excision repair, mismatch repair and damage tolerance.

theme: Mechanoresponsive fibroblast and stromal matrix remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways describe YAP/TAZ-mediated mechanosignalling, focal adhesion assembly and collagen/TGF-beta programmes, framed as the fibroblast activation that builds and remodels connective tissue matrix.

theme: Dolichol pathway and N-linked glycosylation with CDGs
core_role: The shared pathways are dolichyl-phosphate and nucleotide-sugar synthesis and lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly, framed as the early N-glycosylation steps whose defects cause congenital disorders of glycosylation.

theme: Mitotic nuclear envelope dynamics and cell division
core_role: The shared pathways cover nuclear envelope breakdown and reformation, ESCRT-III sealing and abscission, framed as the membrane remodelling events of mitosis alongside chromosome condensation, cohesion and spindle control.

theme: ER protein quality control and secretory exit
core_role: The shared pathways describe ER retention, quality-control compartment, demannosylation and ER-associated retrograde transport, framed as quality control of proteins that have been targeted and inserted into the ER.

theme: Nuclear receptor and circadian control of metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover PPAR, thyroid and ROR/REV-ERB nuclear receptors, PGC-1alpha and the BMAL1-CLOCK circadian clock, framed as transcriptional regulation of metabolism and mitochondrial biogenesis.

theme: Golgi nucleotide-sugar transporter defects in glycosylation disorders
core_role: The shared pathways are SLC35A1/SLC35C1 defects causing CDG2F and CDG2C, framed as failures of the Golgi nucleotide-sugar transport needed for glycosylation.

theme: FGFR1/FGFR3 activation and downstream signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are FGFR1/FGFR3 ligand binding and FRS/SHC cascades, including activating FGFR3 mutants, framed as the receptor signal regulated by Spry and FGFRL1 feedback.

theme: Dendritic cell cytokine responses to pathogens
core_role: The shared pathways cover dendritic cell IL-12, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF production in response to protozoa, framed as the cytokine output of C-type lectin receptor (Dectin-1/2, DC-SIGN) pathogen recognition.

theme: Platelet activation and blood coagulation (hemostasis)
core_role: The shared pathways cover platelet activation by thrombin and ADP and degranulation, framed as the cellular arm of hemostasis coordinated with platelet adhesion, the coagulation cascade and fibrinolysis.
